C: › the nest of an eagle or other large bird that eats meat, usually built in a high place that cannot be easily reached
（通常指築在高處和偏僻處的）猛禽的巢穴，鷹巢
› a room or apartment that is high up in a building
極高處的房間；樓層極高的公寓

example: I interviewed the chairman of the company in his seventh-floor eyrie.
我在位於大樓八樓的房間內採訪了這位公司董事長。
